messages:
sarah.k: Quick heads-up — external pen test starts Mon 03:00 UTC. I dropped a remediation tracker (Drive) and a short SLA doc. Need clarity on two things: KMS evidence access for assessors + minimal RBAC changes during the window.

mike.ops: Drive link please? I can pre-provision ephemeral roles and short-lived keys.

sarah.k: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link - tracker is the sheet named 'PT-Remediate-Tracker-2026' (permissions: security@redwood.com).

olivia.se: For assessors we should avoid giving direct KMS decrypt. Prefer pre-signed evidence bundles or a readroom with wrapped keys. How big are the evidence exports?

mike.ops: Typical bundle ~200MB for full logs. We can push compressed snapshots to a pre-signed S3 URL with server-side encryption (KMS). Assessors get the URL + a short-lived role to download only.

jason.eng: For the KMS side we can use an envelope key approach — create a temporary CMK alias `alias/pt-readroom-<run>` and wrap object keys. Minimal terraform for the proxy:```hcl
resource "aws_kms_key" "pt_readroom" {
  description = "PT read-only key (ephemeral)"
  policy = <<POL
{...restricted policy...}
POL
}
```

olivia.se: Sounds good. Also we need audit-log sampling guidance — do we deliver raw CloudTrail + app logs or a sampled export? Assessors will want sequence continuity for incident repro.

mike.ops: We should give full CloudTrail for the retest window; app logs can be sampled but with contiguous slices around the suspicious timestamps. Export cadence: 1m batches is fine.

security-bot: PT booking confirmed by vendor: red-team-inc. Window: 2026-05-18 to 2026-05-22.

nina.ciso: What's our SLA for remediations & retest scheduling? I want clear tiers so we can respond to the vendor within 48h. Also need CISO signoff requirements for any high/critical findings.

sarah.k: Proposed SLA in the sheet:
- Critical: acknowledge <4h, fix or mitigation plan <72h, retest slot within 7 days.
- High: acknowledge <8h, mitigation plan <5 business days, retest within 14 days.
- Medium/Low: acknowledge in 3 business days, patching in next sprint, retest optional.

mike.ops: I'll own provisioning + generating one-time S3 URLs and the temporary CMK. I'll add steps to the tracker and tag owners.

jason.eng: For RBAC changes we should do read-only role swaps via a canary: add the assessor roles to a small subset of resources first, validate read-only access, then roll to full. Keep rollback plan simple: revoke role binding.

olivia.se: For evidence packaging, let's standardize a manifest file with checksums and a minimal timeline (start/end timestamps) so assessors can validate sequence. Example manifest keys: `start_ts`, `end_ts`, `sha256:logs.gz`.

sarah.k: Action items:
- mike.ops: pre-create alias/pt-readroom-<run> + upload flow (due: Fri EOD)
- jason.eng: RBAC canary playbook + terraform snippet (due: Fri EOD)
- olivia.se: manifest template + sampling guidance (due: Thu)
- nina.ciso: confirm SLA buckets and signoff process (please ack)

mike.ops: ack. I'll put the IAM steps in the tracker and include the exact aws cli commands. :thumbsup:

jason.eng: ack. Will add a rollback snippet and a small smoke test (download manifest, verify checksum).

nina.ciso: ack — I want the SLA doc linked in ticketing and a short escalation path (pager + exec email) for Criticals.

sarah.k: Thanks all. If anything else pops up, @channel, call it out in this thread. We’ll do a 15-min dry run Fri 15:00 UTC to exercise the readroom flow.

mike.ops: FYI here's the download sample command I'll document: ```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-pt-evidence/2026-05-18/logs.gz - | gunzip > logs.json
```

olivia.se: adding one more note — redact PII before upload unless assessors have an NDA exception. We'll add a checklist item in the tracker.

sarah.k: good call. added. :white_check_mark:
